questions.question: Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank. The Blood Finder app is very useful in ______ the correct donor
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate word to fill in the blank.

The Blood Finder app is very useful in ______ the correct donor
questions.solution: 'Locating' should be used because it means to find a particular place or person. The sentence states that the Blood Finder app is very useful in finding the correct donor, making 'locating' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Unlocking' means to open or make accessible, 'Starting' means to begin something, and 'Establishing' implies creating or setting up something, which don't fit in this context

questions.solution: Delay' should be used because it means to slow down or postpone an action or process. The sentence states that if we delay any further, we will lose the contract, making 'delay' appropriate here. Whereas, 'Back' implies moving backwards, 'Late' means occurring after the expected time, and 'Slow' means to reduce speed, which don't correctly convey the nature of action in this context because they do not specifically address the consequence of losing the contract due to inaction

questions.question: Direction: Each of the following items in this section consists of a sentence, parts of which have been jumbled. These parts have been labelled as P, Q, R and S. Given below each sentence has four sequences, namely (A), (B), (C) and (D). You are required to re-arrange the Jumbled parts of the sentence and mark your response accordingly. the European Council directed the European Union (EU) countries in October 2022 (P)/ with the aim of reducing electronic waste, (Q)/ such devices be equipped with a single connector, the standard USB-C (R)/ to introduce legislation within two years mandating that all brands of smartphones, laptops, tablets, cameras and other (S)
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Each of the following items in this section consists of a sentence, parts of which have been jumbled. These parts have been labelled as P, Q, R and S. Given below each sentence has four sequences, namely (A), (B), (C) and (D). You are required to re-arrange the Jumbled parts of the sentence and mark your response accordingly.

the European Council directed the European Union (EU) countries in October 2022 (P)/ with the aim of reducing electronic waste, (Q)/ such devices be equipped with a single connector, the standard USB-C (R)/ to introduce legislation within two years mandating that all brands of smartphones, laptops, tablets, cameras and other (S)
questions.solution:
Q: This part sets the context and purpose of the action described in the sentence.
P: This part introduces the authority (the European Council) and the action (directive) along with the time frame.
S: This part describes the action that the European Council directed the EU countries to undertake.
R: This part specifies the requirement that the legislation should mandate.

questions.question: Direction: Each of the following items in this section consists of a sentence, parts of which have been jumbled. These parts have been labelled as P, Q, R and S. Given below each sentence has four sequences, namely (A), (B), (C) and (D). You are required to re-arrange the Jumbled parts of the sentence and mark your response accordingly. India’s decision to procure 12 Sukhoi 30-MKI (P)/ fighter jets from Russia sends out (Q)/ a clear signal that catering to pressing strategic (R)/ needs is at the core of the country’s defence acquisition policy(S)
questions.questionHtml:
Direction: Each of the following items in this section consists of a sentence, parts of which have been jumbled. These parts have been labelled as P, Q, R and S. Given below each sentence has four sequences, namely (A), (B), (C) and (D). You are required to re-arrange the Jumbled parts of the sentence and mark your response accordingly.

India’s decision to procure 12 Sukhoi 30-MKI (P)/ fighter jets from Russia sends out (Q)/ a clear signal that catering to pressing strategic (R)/ needs is at the core of the country’s defence acquisition policy(S)
questions.solution:
P: This sentence fragment introduces the main subject "India’s decision."
Q: "from Russia" provides additional information about the source of the procurement. "sends out" continues the action related to the decision mentioned in P.
R: "a clear signal" acts as the object of the action from Q ("sends out a clear signal"). "that catering to pressing strategic" provides further explanation about the signal.
S: This completes the thought by specifying what the strategic needs pertain to, finalizing the explanation of the signal's importance.
